This proof executes the original private noncash entitlement-return issuer and
escrow refund owner, the complete P/H/W/generation migration closure, then the
214149 source-owned original-fund split. The original 35 pinned owners and 31
financial triggers remain, with the actual ticket identity, tally and deferred
ledger guards captured read-only on 2026-11-16. No financial journal adapter,
cash tranche, player-wallet refund or positive zero-value ticket is used.

The four previous-entry openings are explicit: completed earned release, mixed
P10/W10 source capital, accepted bust-loss receipt, and terminal-loss receipt.
The actual original fee consumers spend source-exact fees: 2P for full P20,
and 1P/1W for mixed P10/W10. The completed P release refunds 18 usable value
and 2 original-fund principal. The mixed cancellation refunds 10 to the fund
and restores a W10 usable ticket with net prize9/fee1 rails. The actual original
ticket admission redeems that ticket into a new matching tournament, freezes
W10 funding once, and preserves both admission and original refund replay.
The bust and terminal cases return all20 to the fund and cancel the durable
audit ticket. Each verifies a late-journal fault rolling back the complete
issue, escrow, fund, custody and receipt. Original grant targets never reprice
or revive. The admission guard changes only its exact changed signature pin;
its other bytes/ACL and all69 inventory source checks remain unchanged.

These previous-state openings do not qualify their earning/bust/terminal
producers or public cancel/unregister reachability. Those owners have separate
maintained proofs. Actual fee consumption, private refund and net admission
owners execute under the real journal/financial guards.

Run the maintained scripts/ci/test-promo-ticket-principal-returns.py with
--output and --pg-bin. --profit-source and --ticket-tree permit an explicitly
bound local dependency candidate; defaults use the checkout's final sources.
The runner reuses the existing return and public financial bootstraps rather
than replacing their money owners, modes, source pins or guards.
